title: Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite GA: new models and deprecated sampling parameters
description: Gemini 3.6 Flash (gemini-3.6-flash) and Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) are now generally available. Additionally, the sampling parameters temperature, top_p, and top_k are now deprecated for these latest Gemini models. ellmer may need to update its pricing data for these models and review whether its chat interfaces should handle or warn about the deprecated sampling parameters.

title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 preview deprecation (shutdown August 31, 2026)
description: The gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview model will be shut down on August 31, 2026. If ellmer references this model in docs or pricing data, it should be removed or updated.

title: Claude Opus 5 released – new flagship model
description: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, described as a step-change improvement for long-running agents with improvements in coding and professional work. ellmer may need to update its pricing data and consider whether Opus 5 should replace or be added alongside existing Opus model entries.

title: Claude Sonnet 5 released – new mid-tier flagship model
description: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5 on June 30, 2026, delivering frontier performance across coding, agents, and professional work at scale. As a new flagship Sonnet-tier model, ellmer's default model and pricing data for the Sonnet tier may need updating.

title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash official public beta release with Responses API support
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash (deepseek-v4-flash) has been officially released in public beta as of 2026-07-31, replacing the preview version. Notably, it natively supports the Responses API format, which may require ellmer to handle or document this new API surface. ellmer's pricing data and default model references for DeepSeek should be reviewed.

title: Ollama adds native Anthropic Messages API compatibility
description: Ollama gained compatibility with the Anthropic Messages API (announced January 16, 2026), enabling tools like Claude Code to work with Ollama. This is outside the date window (before 2026-07-11), but the August 10 Muse Glimmer entry mentions new native DFlash and image input support in Ollama's MLX engine, which could affect how ellmer handles image inputs via Ollama's API.

title: Muse Glimmer available on Ollama with new image input API support
description: Ollama's MLX engine now includes new native DFlash and image input support introduced alongside the Muse Glimmer model release. If ellmer supports image/vision inputs via Ollama, this new API surface may require attention or testing.

title: Perplexity changelog update (August 2026)
description: Perplexity's changelog page was modified on 2026-08-07, but the page content provided does not include human-readable changelog entries—only markup and styling. No specific API, model, pricing, or capability changes can be extracted from the content provided.
